lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice accepting and declining invitations politely.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague invites another to fika, lunch, or an after-work activity.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Responding to invitations while keeping the social tone friendly.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik invite each other to a simple activity and handle either acceptance or a polite reason for declining.

main_focus.name: polite invitation responses
main_focus.description: Use gärna, tyvärr, and reason clauses to accept, decline, or suggest another time.
model_examples: Tyvärr kan jag inte idag, för jag ska hem tidigt.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use invitation response phrases naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use invitation chunks with clear, friendly reasons.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person invites the other to a simple activity.
dialogue_shape.middle: The response is accepted or declined with a reason and possibly another suggestion.
dialogue_shape.ending: They confirm the arrangement or leave it for another time.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat invite-response frames with natural variation

focus: whether the invitation is accepted or declined
the reason or alternative time given

sentence_focus: one sentence inviting someone with vill du följa med
one sentence accepting with ja gärna
one sentence giving a reason for declining
